welcomeBody.en:
DeepSeek Harness 0.1 remains in testing for Harness developers. Many areas need further improvement, and we welcome feedback from the developer community. DeepSeek Harness's core plugins and foundational APIs will continue to evolve rapidly over the coming months.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence with developers around the world, building on open-source, open, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome Harness developers everywhere to join the DSH plugin ecosystem.
welcomeBody.zh:
DeepSeek Harness 目前的 0.1 版本仍处在面向 Harness 开发者进行测试的阶段，还有许多地方需要持续改进和打磨，希望听取广大开发者的反馈建议。预计 DeepSeek Harness 的核心插件以及基础 API 都会在接下来的一段时间内快速迭代、持续演化。

我们期待与全球开发者一起，在开源、开放、可复用、可组合的基础设施之上，共同探索智能上限。欢迎全球 Harness 开发者加入 DSH 插件生态。

subagentModelSelectionOff.en: Subagents use configured defaults or inherit the parent agent's model. Saved model choices are retained.
subagentModelSelectionOff.zh: 关闭后，Subagent 使用配置的默认模型或继承父 Agent 的模型；已选模型会保留。

subagentModelSelectionPartial.en: Some model providers could not be loaded; saved choices remain removable.
subagentModelSelectionPartial.zh: 部分模型提供方暂时无法加载；已保存的选择仍可移除。

subagentModelSelectionRequired.en: Select at least one model before saving.
subagentModelSelectionRequired.zh: 保存前请至少选择一个模型。

subagentModelSelectionToggle.en: Allow agents to choose models for subagents
subagentModelSelectionToggle.zh: 允许 Agent 为 Subagent 选择模型

webSearchApiKeyHint.en: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
webSearchApiKeyHint.zh: 不写入设置文件。留空表示保持当前密钥。

webSearchApiKeyUnset.en: No key is configured; search is unavailable until one is.
webSearchApiKeyUnset.zh: 未配置密钥；配置之前搜索不可用。

webSearchBaseUrlHint.en: Leave blank to use the provider default.
webSearchBaseUrlHint.zh: 留空则使用提供方默认地址。

webSearchMaxUses.zh: 单次请求最多搜索次数

webSearchMaxUsesHint.en: How many times one request may search before it must answer.
webSearchMaxUsesHint.zh: 一次请求在必须作答前最多可以搜索多少次。

fontSize.description.zh: 仅影响会话内容的字号

changed.en: The file has changed, showing the previous content.
changed.zh: 文件已更新，当前显示为旧内容。

error.notFound.en: File not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.notFound.zh: 文件不存在，可能已被移动或删除。

error.notRegularFile.en: Not a regular file, nothing to display.
error.notRegularFile.zh: 该路径不是普通文件，没有可显示的内容。

error.notText.en: Not a text file, preview is unavailable for now.
error.notText.zh: 非文本文件，暂时无法预览。

error.tooLarge.en: This page exceeds the {limit} limit and cannot be read.
error.tooLarge.zh: 单页内容超过 {limit} 上限，无法读取。

resourceUnavailable.en: The file resource service is unavailable.

entry.other.en: Not a file or a directory, so it cannot be opened.
entry.other.zh: 这不是文件或目录，没法打开。

error.notFound.en: That directory is gone. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.notFound.zh: 这个目录不在了。可能已被移动或删除。

error.outsideWorkspace.en: That directory is outside the workspace, so the sidebar will not read it.
error.outsideWorkspace.zh: 这个目录在工作区之外，侧栏不会读取它。

guide.description.en: Browse files in this session's workspace
guide.description.zh: 浏览会话工作区的文件

noWorkspace.en: This session has no workspace directory.
noWorkspace.zh: 这个会话没有工作区目录。

truncated.en: Too many entries, showing only some of them.
truncated.zh: 条目太多，只显示了一部分。

failed.en: This image could not be displayed.

unsupported.en: Image preview requires the complete file contents.
unsupported.zh: 图片预览需要完整文件内容。

password.en: This PDF requires a password; password-protected previews are not supported.
password.zh: 此 PDF 需要密码，暂不支持预览。

unsupported.en: PDF preview requires the complete file contents.
unsupported.zh: PDF 预览需要完整文件内容。

workerFailed.en: The PDF rendering process could not continue. Please retry.
workerFailed.zh: PDF 渲染进程无法继续，请重试。

dock.splitPaneNarrow.en: Not enough width to split, widen the sidebar
dock.splitPaneNarrow.zh: 栏宽不足，拖宽侧边栏后再分栏

tab.unavailable.en: Nothing here can view this kind of content yet.
tab.unavailable.zh: 这类内容还没有可用的查看方式。

branch.collapse.zh: 收起 {label} 的下级子代理

branch.expand.zh: 展开 {label} 的下级子代理

diagnostic.unsupported.zh: 子代理记录版本不受支持

readonly.body.en: The parent session is offline; reopen it to continue sending messages.
readonly.body.zh: 父会话当前不在线，重新打开父会话后即可继续发送消息。

readonly.oneShot.body.en: One-shot tasks do not accept follow-ups; review the full execution record here.
readonly.oneShot.body.zh: 一次性任务不支持后续消息，可在这里查看完整执行记录。

readonly.title.en: This subagent is read-only for now

block.openSummary.zh: 打开第 {index} 个块的工具调用概述

details.resizeTitle.en: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
details.resizeTitle.zh: 拖动调整大小；双击恢复默认值。

layout.compactionInterrupted.zh: 上下文压缩在完成前被中断。

layout.systemPromptAndToolsUpdated.zh: 系统提示词和工具已更新

record.systemPromptMissing.en: No system prompt in this request
record.systemPromptMissing.zh: 本次请求没有系统提示词

timeline.overviewAria.en: Timeline overview; drag horizontally to focus events
timeline.overviewAria.zh: 时间线概览；水平拖动可聚焦事件

timing.firstTokenUnavailable.zh: 首 token 时间不可用

timing.outputTokensUnavailable.zh: 输出 token 数不可用

delete.desc.en: This removes “{name}” from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.
delete.desc.zh: 将把“{name}”从工作区列表中移除。文件夹与会话记录会保留，其会话将显示在“未分组”下。

search.hasMore.en: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow your search.
search.hasMore.zh: 仅显示前 {n} 条结果，请缩小搜索范围。

search.unavailable.en: Content search is temporarily unavailable. Showing name matches.
search.unavailable.zh: 内容搜索暂不可用，仅显示名称匹配。
